text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israel buries 34 on day of mourning for 73 soldiers killed in helicopter disaster.
- Some active in promoting immigration to Israel, principally from Soviet Union, are living in poverty.
- Israel's Netanyahu to meet PLO's Arafat on Sunday.
- Veteran army reservists volunteer to replace soldiers in Lebanon to allow the conscripts to make condolence calls.
- Army resumes flying troops to Lebanon on Sikorsky CH-53 helicopters, the type involved this week in Israel's worst military air disaster.
- Shas party's Deri interrogated for six hours by police investigating ill-fated appointment of attorney general.
- Commission investigating helicopter crash checking why two craft took off together when they had different destinations.
- Syria's Assad to EU peace envoy: Israel deserves full security and I'm willing to accept that as a principle of the negotiations.
- Banner headline 'List of Death' over half-page photo of handwritten list of those to board ill-fated helicopters.
